artifact.note: What `check --artifact` proves about a built .app. Every component's runtime_resources must be present (by SHA-256), the required first-party files must be present, and no file with a registered extension (scripts, WebAssembly, fonts and tree-sitter query files) may ship unless its digest is a known runtime resource or first-party file. Compiled code (Swift packages, C parsers) cannot be matched by digest; it is covered by the source-tree check and the SBOM.

components.notes: Shipped as SwiftUIMath's mathFonts.bundle resource. The bundle's OFL.txt opens with the STIX/XITS copyright block followed by the full SIL OFL 1.1 text; each other OFL font's own copyright line is recorded in FONT-COPYRIGHTS. Latin Modern Math and TeX Gyre Termes Math are under the GUST Font License (an LPPL-1.3c-based font licence). runtime_resources records the 12 font files by upstream digest; they are not in this repository. This resolves the font-set decision only: all 12 runtime resource digests, licence texts and the final-artifact check remain required.
